t: What to Buy at Costco if You Live Alone | Sporked
How I Shop at Costco While Living Small - by Laura Fenton
s: September 19, 2024 - I also recommend that you do not even enter the parts of the store that sells apparel, housewares, small electrics, and the like (“softlines” in Costco corporate lingo). I only shop the food and “health and beauty” aisles. Sure, I might occasionally miss out on a deal on something I need, but I also don’t get sucked into impulse purchases. There are certain things that people who live in larger homes buy at Costco that I can’t squeeze into my New York City apartment, for example sundries (toilet paper, paper towels, and the extra-large boxes of trash bags) and certain large food containers that won’t fit in my fridge (Castelvetrano Green Olives, I am looking at you).
